speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin's or Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma). The combination of B-symptoms, supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, organomegaly, elevated LDH, and smoking history is highly suspicious for malignancy. We will need a lymph node biopsy for definitive confirmation.
